name: FORGEOPS CONTENT – AI Content Writer
author: Anıl Rıfat Yıldırım

sections.description:
FORGEOPS CONTENT – AI Content Writer is a free, fully functional plugin for manual AI-assisted content generation from a Keyword Pool.

Included functionality:

  • Keyword Pool management.
  • Manual AI-assisted article generation with no plugin-imposed article quota.
  • CSV, TXT and Excel (.xlsx) keyword import.
  • Brand Profile for business-aware content context.
  • Content language and locale controls.
  • SEO title, meta description and focus keyword generation.
  • Yoast SEO and Rank Math metadata integration when those plugins are available.
  • WordPress category and publish-status controls.
  • Activity logs.

AI-generated content can contain inaccurate, incomplete or outdated information. Review generated content before publishing or relying on it.

External services

OpenAI

FORGEOPS CONTENT connects to the OpenAI API only after an administrator enters an OpenAI API key and manually requests content generation. The selected keyword and configured Brand Profile/content context are sent to OpenAI to generate the requested article.

Service provider: OpenAI
Service: https://openai.com/
Terms: https://openai.com/policies/terms-of-use/
Service Terms: https://openai.com/policies/service-terms/
Privacy: https://openai.com/policies/privacy-policy/

No FORGEOPS or Yıldırım Medya licensing, quota, announcement or remote-control service is required or contacted by this plugin.

Source code

All PHP, JavaScript and CSS shipped with this plugin are human-readable source files. No minified or compiled JavaScript bundle is distributed and no build step is required to modify the shipped assets.
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate FORGEOPS CONTENT – AI Content Writer.
  2. Open FORGEOPS CONTENT > AI & Publishing.
  3. Add your own OpenAI API key.
  4. Complete the Brand Profile if desired.
  5. Import or add keywords to the Keyword Pool.
  6. Click Generate Now on the keyword you want to process.
sections.faq:
Is there an article quota?

No. The plugin does not impose an article quota on manual Keyword Pool generation. OpenAI API usage and charges are handled through your own OpenAI account.

Does it automatically process my Keyword Pool?

No. Each article is generated only when an administrator clicks Generate Now for a keyword.

Does the plugin send my OpenAI API key to FORGEOPS or Yıldırım Medya?

No. The key remains in your WordPress installation and is used only for requests to OpenAI.
